title: Ready-made AI services
description: Match a Cairnway task to the pre-trained AWS AI service that does it, with no model to build.

cards.prompt: Pull the line items and totals out of scanned supplier invoices, including the tables.
Score thousands of product reviews as positive, negative, neutral or mixed.
Turn recorded customer-support phone calls into text so they can be searched.
Read order-status updates aloud in a natural-sounding voice on the phone line.
Show product descriptions to shoppers in Spanish, French and German.
Build a chatbot that understands intents such as 'track my order' and asks for the order number.
Recommend products to each shopper based on what they and similar shoppers clicked and bought.
Flag customer-uploaded product photos that contain unsafe or inappropriate content.
Find people's names and addresses (PII) inside the text of support emails before they are stored.
cards.why: Comprehend detects PII entities in text you pass to it. Macie finds sensitive data in objects already stored in S3.

cards.prompt: Read the handwritten notes on scanned warranty-return forms.
Detect which objects, such as tents, boots or backpacks, appear in product images to tag the catalog.
Find the key phrases and the language of incoming customer emails, without training a model.
Create written captions from the audio of product-demo videos.
Sort support emails into Cairnway's own categories (returns, sizing, shipping) with a custom classifier, without managing ML infrastructure.
cards.why: Comprehend custom classification trains on your labelled examples and runs as a managed service.

cards.prompt: Show 'customers who viewed this also viewed' suggestions that update as a shopper browses.
Let a voice assistant on the support line understand what callers ask for and respond.
cards.why: Lex builds the conversation: it recognizes intents in speech or text. Transcribe only converts speech to text and Polly only speaks.
